games.description: A solo sandbox session as a chaotic modern-day Jesus. Sark judges citizens, experiments with money and miracles, flies around the city and tests vehicles before leaving the unfinished world.
games.title: Jesus Christ Simulator

games.description: Sark learns the range’s overnight rules and repeatedly balances tables, mascots, repairs and camera checks while avoiding its creatures. Successive attempts turn the initially confusing shift into a clearer survival routine.
games.title: Russell's Range

games.description: Sark joins the Waste Warriors, gathering resources and trying to operate the Eco-Collector. Crafting tools, feeding the machine and surviving its flashing enemies prove less straightforward than advertised.
games.title: Shush

games.description: Sark’s security job spirals into dark forests, bizarre enemies and a series of increasingly strange puzzles.
